title: After the Debut: A Step Toward Founding a Kingdom

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: HaaaaaAAH—!!
(Uooogh...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“So that’s Rose Kingdom of the Rosen clan!”
“Pisa and Rose. What an incredible lineup of talent.”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(—I can see it. Flickers of hope and expectation
are beginning to light up the spectators' eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Have I demonstrated my true ability, I wonder?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...—Alright.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Rose-san!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you for such a magnificent race.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The honor is mine. It was precisely because of your presence that my debut race shone all the brighter.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. If anything,
I was simply overwhelmed by your presence, Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I, too... must work so much harder.
If I truly wish to weave our circle together.
Her debut race proved to be a display that established her presence as 'Rose Kingdom of the Rose Clan.' Above all—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming to meet me.
In my debut race, I shall certainly—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Are you... crying?
Are you all right?
choice_data_list: No, I'm just so happy you were able to debut—

text_block_list.text:
Above all else... the sight of her racing forward
while shouldering such tremendous burdens was so radiant
that tears spilled from my eyes and refused to stop.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Once again—thanks to your efforts, we achieved
a more than satisfactory result in our debut. You have my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I shall return to the lodgings to rest.
Please, consider today your day off and spend it at your leisure.

text_block_list.name: Racing Enthusiast
text_block_list.text:
Rose Kingdom, the rising star of the Rose Clan!
Perhaps that curse of thorns will finally be broken now!

text_block_list.name: Racing Novice A
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, I've been wondering for a while now...
What exactly is this "Curse of Thorns" anyway—?

text_block_list.name: Racing Novice B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I was wondering about that too!
What exactly is the Rose Clan, anyway...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (... Even after my debut race, there are still those who do not know of our lineage.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Naturally, it cannot be helped.
The perceptions of the public do not always align with ideals.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Yet, I cannot afford to remain complacent.
It is proof that the road to our Rose Kingdom
of eternal peace remains long indeed.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(What I must accomplish—is to carve out victory,
and make the name of the Rose Clan resound through racing history.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(If our name is preserved and made widely known across the world, in time
we shall become an immutable presence known to all.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(That is the prelude to the eternal peace of the Rose Kingdom.
If so, then as I thought—)

On our way back from her debut race—
Rose Kingdom had a proposal for me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I wish to achieve a GⅠ victory in the swiftest manner possible.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It was something I had considered from the start.
However, witnessing the state of the public yesterday cemented my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A Rose Kingdom of enduring peace.
The road leading there is still vastly long.
That is why I wish to bring about its founding as swiftly as possible.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Founding a nation is merely the beginning.
For what comes after holds far more that must be accomplished.

And with that, she lowered her gaze,
as if lost in thought.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I believe I have not told you this yet.
I have an exemplar whom I look up to as someone worthy of kingship.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: His name was Moss the Wise. He founded a splendid kingdom and protected his people from countless disasters—a king among dogs.
choice_data_list: The dog... King of Dogs... you say?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A character from a children's book
I was fond of reading when I was young.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I hold King Moss in the highest esteem...
Seeing my devotion, my mother even gifted me a plush doll made in his likeness.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Those fangs and claws could shatter mountains,
and that wisdom surpassed even the greatest of sages.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Possessing overwhelming power to cut through adversity.
A presence who brings hope to the people all on his own.
That is the wise King Moss.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: It is my origin, and my ideal.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Merely a fairy tale.
And yet, a fairy tale all the same.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I learned a great many things from that king.
That founding a kingdom is merely the beginning is one such lesson.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Establishing a nation's prestige and building a solid foundation.
These things require a great deal of time and effort.

In short, 'seize a G1 as quickly as possible'—
a decision made with the long road ahead in mind,
looking far beyond the nation's founding.

If so, the earliest GⅠ race she could aim for
with her running would be
the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, or perhaps—
Hailed as the royal road, this Junior Class championship match draws a great host of contenders aspiring to the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The Triple Crown trail—a treacherous path, yet the glory earned upon it is second to none.

The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.
The collective name for these supreme stages is the Classic Triple Crown trail.
Winning even one is hailed as a monumental feat, and whoever conquers all three is etched into racing history for ages to come as a 'Triple Crown Umamusume'.

Yet throughout its long history,
a mere six souls have ever reached that throne.

That is precisely why it is worth challenging.
To make the Kingdom of Roses truly radiant,
there is no greater grand avenue.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The Asahi Hai FS, where contenders for the Classic Triple Crown gather—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is a stage worthy of breaking the curse of thorns.
There, I shall surely forge our kingdom.

That night, with victory in the Asahi Hai FS in our sights,
we restructured the training regimen from scratch.

She said she had intended to all along.
Between the recent soiree and this, her passion is...
tremendous, as expected.

If we are truly to fulfill our long-cherished ambition
in the Asahi Hai FS together with her――

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Toward a future where the crimson rose blooms!

text_block_list.name: People
text_block_list.text: Toward a future where the crimson rose blooms!

Rather than merely chasing after her back,
I must become worthy of standing by her side.

So that Rose Kingdom can lean on me with peace of mind
and strive toward fulfilling her long-cherished dream.
choice_data_list: (First, let's tackle what needs to be done, one thing at a time.)

text_block_list.text:
—Ahead of our next race, the Asahi Hai FS,
I contacted a certain individual.
